note: Frozen from a real Scout run (2026-06-09, focused breadth, 9 candidates). Candidate names are VERBATIM Scout output — the aspirational framing is part of what is being tested. rough_description values are representative rather than verbatim; replace them with the actual Scout output for highest fidelity (see README).

candidate.name: receipt_photo_ocr_parsing
candidate.rough_description: Extract line items (product name, quantity, price) from a photographed grocery receipt and convert them into structured inventory entries.

candidate.name: barcode_data_enrichment
candidate.rough_description: Look up product details (name, category, typical shelf life) from a barcode scan using a product database API.

candidate.name: smart_expiry_prediction
candidate.rough_description: Given a product category and purchase date, compute an estimated expiry date using a shelf-life reference table.

candidate.name: expiration_alert_optimization
candidate.rough_description: Determine when to send an expiry reminder notification based on item category, days-until-expiry threshold, and user notification preferences.

candidate.name: recipe_suggestion_engine
candidate.rough_description: Given the user's current inventory, suggest recipes that use ingredients expiring soonest, generating a short list with instructions.

candidate.name: recipe_personalization
candidate.rough_description: Learn a user's dietary preferences, restrictions, and past recipe choices to rank and filter recipe suggestions to match their taste profile.

candidate.name: intelligent_shopping_list_generation
candidate.rough_description: Generate a shopping list by comparing current inventory levels against a user-defined par stock for each product category.

candidate.name: shopping_list_optimization
candidate.rough_description: Sort and group a shopping list by store section (produce, dairy, frozen, etc.) using a fixed aisle-mapping table for a given store.

candidate.name: inventory_sort_and_prioritization
candidate.rough_description: Sort and display inventory items in order of expiry date, with items expiring soonest shown first.
